method_note: All Dodge/Chrysler/FCA/Stellantis material counts as ONE source; all Wikipedia articles count as one. confirmed = NHRA + at least 2 independent non-NHRA sources (Dodge counted once). hp is advertised gross through 1971, SAE net from 1972. Several Dodge catalogs (1960, 1961 4-bbl variants, 1972-76) confirm availability but print no brake hp; that is noted per entry.
